activation: Under pivot_review source_linked_pivots_v1, exception_candidate_v1 family self_cover, preleg route atr_displacement with end_bar_id equal to event_bar_id.
rules: Wave start precedes the event. Closed, available, own-timeframe event must have a positive incoming-side shadow.
Use start open to event low for support or event high for resistance. Use explicitly selected baseline_atr and existing three-ATR threshold; other thresholds require method review.
Measure only after cumulative event data availability. The measurement object distinguishes the event endpoint from the pre-event inspected candle span.
Direction and noise review stop before the event. It cannot be a third directional body or settle an earlier counter-bar by a purported preleg close.
This source-supported extension does not apply automatically to pinbar or long_shadow families.
Shape, zone construction, source context and timeframes remain separate checks. Always retain needs_exception_review and no automatic confirmation exemption.
Existing pre-event endpoints and ordinary pivots keep their prior interpretation. No source image is converted into invented OHLC, ATR or historical availability.
source_adjudication: Source-answer labels and image readings are not independent human/model validation or proof of universal thresholds.
